Figure1: SafeOT-Dual combines jointly solved budget prices with cost feedback for the actor. Lagrangian prices rise after observed violations. Bottom: task-median cost/B over training; shading marks excess above one. Headline V ratios use original five-seed SafePO task medians and Bullet ratios of suite means, not shaded areas. Counts report lower-V tasks against TRPO-Lag. Exact settings have c = 0; LP and saturated-clip limits require assumptions.
Figure2: SafeOT-Dual adds joint flow pricing to a standard policy update. Gray modules are standard RL; colored modules build and solve the budgeted graph, then combine its clipped, filtered dual prices with observed-cost feedback. Width encodes visits: projection shifts flow away from the costly route while excluding hard edges. Only prices enter PPO/TRPO; the target flow is not executed. The feedback equation illustrates projected ascent; implementations may use an adaptive optimizer.
